title: S4-EXPORT-09 — Palette motion becomes a loop.
goal: With a cycle track over Bun's colors 2 to 5, Cycle Loop is ready to export a loop (no warning, download enabled) and downloads without changing the stored artwork.

steps.alert: Add an enabled cycle in Palette and choose at least two colors.
steps.why: Without a cycle there is nothing to loop, and the dialog says so.
With an enabled two-colour range the loop can be exported.
Exporting palette motion never rewrites the stored artwork.

cliOnly: decoding the loop: frames vary only inside the chosen palette range at the canvas size (scripts/testsprite/pixibun-remaining-integrity.py cycle)
